My all-time favorite stitch for beginners…is the MINI BEAN STITCH 🧶✨ Full tutorial below ⬇️ Save this so you can crochet along! 📌  📝 INSTRUCTIONS • Chain an odd number of stitches. • Beginning in the 3rd chain from the hook, insert your hook, yarn over and pull up a loop. • Yarn over, insert your hook into the same chain, yarn over and pull up another loop. • You should now have 4 loops on your hook. • Yarn over and pull through all 4 loops. • Chain 1 to close the stitch. Repeat across Row 1: • Skip 1 chain. • Work 1 mini bean stitch into the next chain. • Repeat *skip 1 chain, mini bean stitch in next chain* across. Row 2 and all following rows: • Chain 2 and turn. • Work 1 mini bean stitch into the first chain-1 space from the previous row. • Continue working 1 mini bean stitch into each chain-1 space across. • Chain 2, turn, and repeat this same row for the remainder of your project. 💡 BEGINNER TIPS • Pull your loops up TALL - loose tension is the secret to this stitch! ⭐️ • Also called the Elizabeth stitch, in case you see that name 🧶  ❤️ this post if this is your first time seeing the mini bean stitch - and follow along for beginner patterns that actually make sense! #minibeanstitch #crochettutorial #crochetforbeginners #learntocrochet #beginnercrochet
